summary: Read the hub whole and all 38 source pages (frontmatter link block plus every body passage on hilaritas, joy, tristitia, the primitives). Of 38 links: 18 cut, 11 labelled, 4 retyped (Four Virtues to contradicts; Confucianism to mirrors; Photonic Time Crystals and Floquet to exemplifies), 5 kept. The pattern: where a source really speaks of the hub it names one of three things - the measure (How do you feel), a design primitive (cross-domain moment, real thing, edge of capability), or the hub as a station in a story (Cooperation Path, Enchantment, Fortress/Threshold). The cuts are labels with nothing behind them (Typography, Maker, Hero and Avatar Maker, Flocking, Generative Compression, Meadows) plus two duplicates of links the hub already holds (Cooperation Yields Agency, Kuramoto). Could not settle: whether Comic and Cinema, Parametric Resonance and Alexander earn their links (all low or medium: one sentence, hub side general); whether the Four Virtues tension is a true contradiction or an open question. No newcomer inbound links proposed - none of the nine newcomers appears among the pages I read, and I did not force one.
